description: Data for up to 50 Steam games by Steam ID. Prices are USD cents (basePrice, minimumPrice; minimumPrice is the lowest price Markan has seen, null if not yet known). Choose fields to keep the answer small; default: steamId, title, type, releaseDate, basePrice, numReviews, reviewScoreDesc, shortDescription, tags, genres, developers, publishers.

fields.description: Which fields to return; leave out for a useful default set (title, release date, price, reviews, short description, tags...). Prices are in US cents.

steam_ids.description: Steam app IDs (the number in a store URL), from find_games or search_games.

name: get_games
title: Get Steam game data
